title: Prior Wrong-Address Violations in Dispute Decisions — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** When a wrong-address dispute is decided on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, the prior-address reduction counts the other wrong-address violations recorded on the account less than twelve whole months before the decision, the disputed one not counted: 2 or more take off 2 points; exactly one takes off 1 point; none takes off nothing.

| Other wrong-address violations in the twelve months before the decision | Prior-address reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 points |
| Exactly 1 | 1 point |
| None | Nothing |

## Counting (hypothetical accounts)

| Wrong-address violations in the twelve months, the disputed one included | Others | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | Nothing |
| 2 | 1 | 1 point |
| 4 | 3 | 2 points |

Violations of other types are not counted, and a wrong-address violation recorded more than twelve whole months before the decision falls outside the count.
